notes.title: IF YOU PURCHASE ONE GAME... THEN PURCHASE BALDURS GATE 3... BUT...
notes.notes:
.... If you purchase another game PLEASE MAKE IT BODY ELECTRIC! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2jkytEJQDjI

This COMPLETE REDESIGN features DX11 and DX12 compatibility, NVIDIA DLSS 3 integration, Endless level generation, 50 custom Tiles (and counting!), Actual AI enemies to engage and who respond to your presence, a working inventory, a 'Para-Jet' to get you around the level quicker (OP but it's fun for now), weapon selection and modifications upgrades, Skills Tree, 24 hour day night cycle, A completely swimmable subterranean level beneath the city, and the list goes on! 

Please Let me know what you think, take pictures and leave a REVIEW!!!

notes.title: DIRECTX11 Compatibility
notes.notes: Had some issues with the game not starting or finishing loading then quiting. DirectX12 was the culprit and I exported this current version with strictly DirectX11 support so it should be compatible with most systems!

notes.title: ALPHA 2.0 IS LIVE!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=2jkytEJQDjI;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey ALL! 

I missed the day for release by 5 days and for that I am sorry! 

After the release of the Alpha v1 in November I was offered a Fellowship for World Building from UNREAL! I  then took everything I had learned and poured the next 4 months into what you see here! Please review and post some pictures! I'm dying to know what you think!

What you have now is the latest version that includes my main character,  PB76, and a light inventory. There are points of interest and as much of the world as I've been able to build (which is a lot!).  

Thank you for your patience and please enjoy the latest build of BODY. ELECTRIC.!
